subject: Access provenance & service-account scoping for SOC 2: SCIM sync replay and role cleanup
messages:
From: Sally Tan <sally.tan@nightingalehealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@nightingalehealth.com>, external-auditor@mcafeegroup.com
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Access provenance request — service accounts & SCIM delta replay

Hi Rishi,

We are preparing for our SOC 2 readiness review next month and need a concise package showing how Redwood scopes and controls service accounts and ephemeral admin access. Specifically the auditors asked for:
- A short listing of service accounts that have broad privileges (owner/edit) and their stated business justification.
- A SCIM delta sample covering the last 7 days (adds/removes/role changes) for our tenant.
- Evidence of any ephemeral/admin JIT grants and the owner who approved them (audit trail/events).

Can you confirm you can provide a scoped extract and a proposed timeline? If you prefer, we can accept redacted data and a replay script rather than raw logs.

Thanks — we need to lock this down by May 24.

—Sally
Sally Tan
Head of Security Ops, Nightingale Health
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sally Tan <sally.tan@nightingalehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access provenance request — service accounts & SCIM delta replay

Hi Sally — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide a scoped deliverable that matches the auditor needs while keeping PII/redacted where appropriate. Proposed deliverables and plan below:

Deliverables: 
1) Access snapshot (redwood-formatted JSON) listing active service accounts, roles, and last use timestamp — attachment: access-snapshot-20260516.json.
2) SCIM delta sample (CSV) showing add/modify/delete events for the requested 7-day window — attachment: scim_delta_sample.csv (redacted usernames).
3) Short runbook describing JIT/ephemeral admin flow, approval owner, and link to the audit events — attachment: service-account-decomm-plan.docx (this also includes the cleanup schedule).

Workback / ETA:
- Today (May 17): I will generate the redacted SCIM delta sample and access snapshot and circulate for internal review.
- May 18: Internal sign-off with Laura; push the artifacts to the secure Drive link and share a replay script for the auditor.
- May 19: Final packaging and short QA (I will include MD5 hashes and a manifest).

Questions for you: do auditors need original event IDs (we can provide), or are timestamps + actor sufficient (preferred)? Also confirm whether the replay should be a sanitized script we run and share output, or a CSV that they run locally.

I'm looping in Laura (controls) to confirm the role-cleanup window and Ben for the extraction run.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference

> 
> We are preparing for our SOC 2 readiness review next month and need a concise package showing how Redwood scopes and controls service accounts and ephemeral admin access....
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Access provenance request — service accounts & SCIM delta replay

Thanks Rishi — a couple of operational notes and a proposed cleanup cadence: 

Operational notes:
- We'll scope 'broad privilege' service accounts to those with Organization-level Owner or cross-tenant Editor roles. That will keep the scope tight for the auditors.
- For ephemeral/JIT admin events we will pull approval metadata from the access-request service (it contains approver id, justification, TTL).

Role-cleanup proposal: 
1) Day 0 (May 18): Identification and owner reach-out (owners listed in access-snapshot).
2) Day 1–2 (May 19–20): Owners confirm whether account requires full privileges; if not, schedule role reduction.
3) Day 3–7 (May 21–25): Execute role reductions and collect post-change snapshots.

I've attached a short plan (service-account-decomm-plan.docx) with a small script snippet Ben can run to produce the SCIM delta CSV and a verification checklist. Ben — can you run the extraction on Tue morning (May 19) and drop the CSV to the Drive folder? I'll do owner outreach today.

Laura Bennett
Director, Product Security | Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Will run the extraction first thing Thursday (05/20) morning PST and push sanitized CSV to the Drive link. I verified the script ensures: remove email local parts, hash user ids, and keep event IDs (if auditors request them) in a separate sealed file. ETA for deliverable: 05/20 EOD PST.
